item.title: Iaeger man arrested at Mardi Gras Casino faces first degree murder charges in the death of his father in McDowell County
item.description: A man taken into custody while naked inside the Mardi Gras Casino and Resort now faces first-degree murder in the death of his father. Authorities confirm that 33-year-old Thomas Jeffrey Lawson Junior, of Iaeger, was arraigned late Sunday in Kanawha County Magistrate Court.
